Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.ops

Class TradeOpsRepository

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.ops.TradeOpsRepository
@Repository public class TradeOpsRepository extends Object
Read-only access to a trade's audit records across the trading tables and iam.clients.

    • findAwaitingExecutionSince

      public List<TradeSummary> findAwaitingExecutionSince(OffsetDateTime submittedBefore)
      Orders still SUBMITTED or ACCEPTED that were submitted before the given time, across every client, oldest first, up to MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS. OPEN orders are left out: they wait for their price by design.
      Parameters:
      submittedBefore - only orders submitted before this
      Returns:
      the orders awaiting execution
